description: Named loop_policy presets for /loop-level. Each level materializes literal values into a project's .claude/stack-config.json loop_policy + cost_protection blocks — it is not read at loop-run time. loop-engineer/loop_lib.sh/loop-stop.sh/loop-cost-monitor.sh only ever read the resulting literal fields, unchanged by this file's existence. Raising a level is always safety-relevant (change_history + reason required). irreversible_actions_break_loop is a cross-level invariant, never set by a preset, and must never be forced to false by /loop-level regardless of level.

L1.label: Bounded — same caps as tier default, just no checkpoint pauses

L2.label: Extended — longer unattended runs, moderate budget

L4.label: Maximum — full-day unattended jobs, highest cost exposure

invariants.note: Every level keeps pushes/merges/deploys/deletes gated. /loop-level must refuse to write irreversible_actions_break_loop: false at any level, and must refuse to write a null per_session_hard_cap_usd for L3 or L4 (both presets above already carry a non-null value; do not let a user override it to null when applying L3/L4).
